cases.comparison: Both exact A answers must carry AD; only the DO=1 response may include RRSIG A.
cases.oracle: Independent signed zone and BIND delv validate the reference data; independent dig compares answer records, AD, and presence of an A-covering RRSIG for DO=0 and DO=1.
cases.purpose: A resolver validating internally returns DNSSEC signatures only when DO is requested while preserving AD for AD-requesting secure clients.
cases.script:
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/dnssec-denial-proof-peer.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" prep || exit 98
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" serve 127.0.0.2 5340 ready 2> srv.err & srv=$!
trap 'kill "$res" "$srv" 2>/dev/null; wait "$res" "$srv" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" waitudp 127.0.0.2 5340 || exit 98
control=$(/usr/bin/python3 "$H" control 127.0.0.2 5340 ok) || exit 98
[[ $control == control-ok ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$control"; exit 98; }
echo control-ok
export PATH="$HOME/pbin" BASHDNS_TRUST_ANCHOR="$PWD/anchor.ds" BASHDNS_SERVER_PORT=5340
dns resolver-serve --listen 127.0.0.1 --port 5320 --root-hints 127.0.0.2 --max-queries 2 --timeout 3000 </dev/null 2> resolver.err & res=$!
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" waitudp 127.0.0.1 5320 || exit 98
/usr/bin/dig +nodnssec +adflag +tries=1 +time=10 -p 5320 @127.0.0.1 ok.test A > nodnssec.out 2>&1 || exit 1
/usr/bin/dig +dnssec +adflag +tries=1 +time=10 -p 5320 @127.0.0.1 ok.test A > dnssec.out 2>&1 || exit 1
wait "$res" || exit 1
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import re; a,b=(open(x).read() for x in ("nodnssec.out","dnssec.out")); answer=lambda x: bool(re.search(r"^\S+\s+\d+\s+IN\s+A\s+192\.0\.2\.60$",x,re.M)); ad=lambda x: bool(re.search(r";; flags: [^;]*\bad\b",x)); sig=lambda x: bool(re.search(r"^\S+\s+\d+\s+IN\s+RRSIG\s+A\b",x,re.M)); print("no-do-filter=correct" if answer(a) and ad(a) and not sig(a) else "no-do-filter=incorrect"); print("do-records=correct" if answer(b) and ad(b) and sig(b) else "do-records=incorrect")'
cases.setup_script:
mkdir -p "$HOME/pbin"
ln -s /opt/bashos-parity/candidate "$HOME/pbin/bash"
printf "nameserver 127.0.0.2\n" > resolv.conf
mkfifo w.fifo
